name: @role-orchestrator/checkpoint
description: M4-02 approval checkpoints + bounded continuation. When an execution's event stream or result payload carries a structured action proposal, the capability gate decides the channel (A19): no verified interactive approval channel means NO faked mid-run pause - the current execution safely ends, the proposal becomes a one-shot approval (@role-orchestrator/approval), and the node waits (WAITING_APPROVAL via the dag state machine). A proposal whose action type relies on the interactive channel while the gate cell is unverified is refused outright (fail-closed). After a user approves, continueAfterApproval creates ONE new execution (fresh attempt under the A23 single-active-attempt constraint, dispatch outbox message) that presents the approved action for consumption (actionDigest CAS, A17/A18) and executes from the run's FROZEN profile snapshot (readRunRoleProfile, A34) - the checkpoint path itself never performs the proposed side effect.
